title: These are not 700 gsm
text:
These are not 700 gsm. These towels are decent, but in no way are they 700gsm. They seem to be well made and after washing and drying, are soft, but in no way are they heavy enough compared to other towels I bought from Amazon that are 703 gsm. Unfortunately, those were unavailable, so I had to opt for these. It remains to be seen how well they hold up.

After washing these, I have noticed the color fading on the hand towels for some reason. I am going back to the 703 gsm towels from the Luxury Towel Company. They are perfect and truly as described. I am adding to the previous reviews as to the total colorfastness of these towels. All have started fading at this point. I have washed in cold water only with an HE detergent without chemicals. I bought these in the dark gray color, so it is very obvious the fading is showing up.
